title: Andrzej Wajda, 100 th Anniversary of Birth
descriptionPlain: Description For those who grew up with his films. For those who learned to see history, courage and responsibility through his cinema. For everyone for whom he became a lasting point of reference. A silver collector coin issued to mark the 100th anniversary of his birth. Featuring an authentic quotation drawn from the Master’s personal notebooks, reproduced in the distinctive character of his handwriting. From values expressed through film to values preserved in silver.
